title: Harness notice:

items.content: Add `chat_tab` to `AgentView`; `show_agent_chat` saves the outgoing tab and returns the incoming one
Restore the tab in `cmd_set_active_agent`; keep LOG override; drop bench-run rule; ask once
Add per-agent tab tests (restore, single ask, scroll kept, background untouched, log override)
Run fmt, clippy -D warnings, and tests for aura-ui-terminal and aura-desktop
Review fixes: quiet TIME restore (`FlowState::restore_mode`), no timeline sync on another agent's flow, typed-text guard on restore, make the folds round-trip test exercise `Kept`, add tests
Amend CHANGELOG/docs with the typed-text rule (after docs agent reports)
Final compact review of the whole diff

summary: The final check passes: - **Formatting:** rustfmt is clean on every file this change touched. - **Lints:** clippy with warnings denied is clean for `aura-ui-terminal` and `aura-desktop`. I ran it with `--no-deps`, because without it an existing lint in `aura-core-types`, a crate this change doesn't touch, fails the run. - **Tests:** `aura-ui-terminal` 889 passed, 0 failed (up from 880 before this…
